Kerala Cleric's Remarks on Women Spark Controversy

A controversy has erupted in Kerala following remarks made by a local cleric regarding women. The cleric stated that women are like gold and should be kept in safe boxes. He also suggested that women venturing outside could lead to great destruction. These statements have drawn criticism and debate.
